original_hypothesis: an exact KV cache is a pure serving materialization (TMT-6): it changes NO output and only moves work from compute to memory, so its whole value is a crossover in the declared memory price mu, and that crossover is a closed form in (prefix length P, continuation length C, reuse R, head width d) that is INDEPENDENT of layer count L and head count H_kv -- because both the mult saving and the cache size scale as L*H_kv and the factor cancels. The corollary is that the cache is worth exactly NOTHING (mu* = 0) for a single one-token continuation, since the prefix must be computed either way: the entire benefit is bought by reuse and by continuation length, never by caching as such
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED microscope gmi_microscope/b2_kv.py: an exact rational decoder with L layers, H heads of width d = 2, dyadic-kernel causal attention (weights 2^s so softmax normalization is exact), residual stack, token embedding embed(tok,t) = [tok, t mod 2]; all weights and all tokens are declared deterministic functions of their indices, so there is NO randomness anywhere. Arms RECOMPUTE (full forward over the whole prefix at every decode step), CACHE (prefill the prefix once, store every exact (K,V), extend one token per step, and REUSE the prefix cache across all R continuations) and the negative twin STALE (a cache built on the ORIGINAL prefix, continued after the prefix is MUTATED, against a correctly invalidated cache and against ground truth). Metered: projection mults (d^2 per K or V per head per token) and attention mults (2d per (query, source) pair) separately; cache elements RETAINED BETWEEN decode steps; declared price total = mults + mu * cache_elems with crossover mu* = delta_mults / delta_cache_elems. Cells (P, C, R, L, H): P4_C1_R1, P4_C4_R1, P4_C4_R8, P16_C4_R1, P16_C8_R4, P16_C1_R8, P32_C8_R16 at L=4,H=2, plus P16_C8_R4 repeated at (L,H) = (2,4) and (8,1). DISCLOSED CALIBRATION of TWO cells before freezing: P4_C1_R1 -- outputs identical, mults 800 vs 800 (proj 320 vs 320), cache elements 160, mu* = 0, meters match the closed form, cache elements match 2LndH_kv, stale twin differs from truth and the invalidated twin equals truth; P4_C4_R1 -- outputs identical, mults 4864 vs 1664 (proj 1664 vs 512), cache elements 256, mu* = 25/2, all four booleans as above. The remaining SEVEN cells were NOT run before this freeze; their predicted values below are computed from the closed form alone
why_justified: B2.12 asks for exact output equality plus the compute-memory crossover, and both are decidable without training anything: equality is a referential-transparency statement in exact rational arithmetic, and the crossover is an op-count ratio against a declared memory price. The L/H_kv-independence of mu* is a non-obvious consequence that the same run tests for free, and the stale-cache twin makes TMT-6's immutability assumption a measured rather than an assumed condition
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) RECOMPUTE and CACHE produce BIT-IDENTICAL outputs in all NINE cells (exact rational equality at every emitted position of every continuation). (2) The measured meters equal the closed form in all nine cells, with these exact totals (mults recompute / mults cache / ratio): P4_C1_R1 800 / 800 / 1; P4_C4_R1 4864 / 1664 / 38:13; P4_C4_R8 38912 / 9280 / 608:145; P16_C4_R1 27904 / 8000 / 436:125; P16_C8_R4 270336 / 28416 / 352:37; P16_C1_R8 47872 / 10240 / 187:40; P32_C8_R16 3112960 / 176640 / 1216:69; and the two (L,H) variants of P16_C8_R4 reproduce 270336 / 28416 EXACTLY. (3) Peak retained cache elements equal 2*L*d*H_kv*(P+C) EXACTLY in all nine cells: 160, 256, 256, 640, 768, 544, 1280, 768, 768. (4) mu* = 0, 25/2, 463/4, 311/10, 315, 1176/17, 2294 in the seven L=4,H=2 cells, and mu* = 315 in BOTH (L,H) variants -- i.e. mu* is independent of L and of H_kv to the last digit. (5) mu* is EXACTLY ZERO at P4_C1_R1: with one continuation of one token the cache saves nothing at all, and the mult counts are equal (800 = 800), not merely close. (6) mu* rises with reuse at fixed (P,C): 25/2 at R=1 becomes 463/4 at R=8, a factor 9.26; and at C=1 with R=8 (P16_C1_R8) mu* = 1176/17 > 0, so reuse alone -- with no continuation length at all -- already makes the cache worth paying memory for. (7) The negative twin holds in every cell: the STALE cache (built on the original prefix, continued after a one-token prefix mutation) DIFFERS from ground truth, while the correctly invalidated cache EQUALS it -- so TMT-6's exactness is conditional on prefix immutability and the microscope measures that condition rather than assuming it. (8) Attention mults are NOT equal between the arms (the recompute arm re-reads the whole prefix at every step), so the saving is not confined to projections; both components are reported separately

source_result: GMI_BIOSPHERE_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL_V1.md stage B2 row B2.3 (fixed vs dynamic routing: generate exact required edge sets E(x) with controlled |union E(x)| - E|E(x)|; arms fixed sparse / fixed dense / dynamic score-select / oracle dynamic; primary test: measured advantage vs the TM-2 opportunity); theorem TMT-3 (fixed-routing union lower bound), whose implementation check X-TMT3 is GREEN in GMI_TRANSFORMER_MICROFEATURE_EXACT_RECEIPT_V1.json; registry entries TF-010, TF-017, TF-019 and TF-083
original_hypothesis: TMT-3's structural routing opportunity c_e(|union E(x)| - E|E(x)|) is an upper bound on what dynamic routing can win, and it is NOT realizable at a unit discovery price: discovering which of k candidates to use costs k score evaluations, which is the same order as materializing all k edges, so at c_s = c_e the MINIMAL SAFE FIXED graph beats the dynamic router in every cell. The further claim is that the advantage usually attributed to dynamic routing is systematically overstated because it is measured against the DENSE baseline: the dense-minus-oracle gap is k - j while the theorem's bound is only |union| - j, so the overstatement is exactly k - |union| and it is entirely the difference between the dense graph and the minimal safe sparse graph, not a property of dynamic routing at all
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED microscope gmi_microscope/b2_route.py: one routing stage over k = 16 source positions feeding one target; source s carries a declared exact rational value val(s); an input declares a required source set P(x) of size j drawn from a support S of size q and the obligation is out(x) = sum over P(x) of val(s). An arm transports ONLY what it materializes, so it is exact on x iff its materialized set contains P(x). Families POINTER(q,j) (every j-subset of S = {0..q-1}; union = q, mean = j, gap = q - j) and WINDOW(j) (one input-independent required set; gap = 0, the control matching X-TMT3's local_window_2 row). Arms FIXED_DENSE (all k, cost c_e k), FIXED_SPARSE(B) (the B lowest indices, cost c_e B, swept over B = 0..k), DYNAMIC (score all k then materialize the top j, cost c_s k + c_e j, exact by construction) and ORACLE (materialize P(x), cost c_e j), plus the negative twin DYNAMIC_BLIND whose score is query-INDEPENDENT (identical cost, discovery information removed). Prices c_e = 1 and c_s in {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 0}. Every input of every family is ENUMERATED; no sampling and no RNG. Cells POINTER at (q,j) = (1,1), (2,1), (4,1), (8,1), (16,1), (8,4), (16,4), (16,8) and WINDOW(4). DISCLOSED CALIBRATION of TWO cells before freezing: POINTER_q4_j1 -- 4 inputs, union 4, mean 1, TMT-3 bound 3, minimal safe fixed budget 4, dense/dynamic exact 1 and blind twin 1/4, sparse curve matches the binomial prediction, dense-minus-oracle gap 15, overstatement 12, c_s* = 3/16, and the frontier excluding the oracle is FIXED_SPARSE at c_s in {1, 1/2, 1/4} and DYNAMIC at c_s in {1/8, 1/16, 0}; WINDOW_j4 -- 1 input, union 4, mean 4, bound 0, minimal safe fixed budget 4, blind twin exact 1, dense-minus-oracle gap 12, overstatement 12, c_s* = 0, and FIXED_SPARSE wins at every positive c_s. The remaining SEVEN cells were NOT run before this freeze
why_justified: B2.3 asks for the measured advantage against the TM-2/TMT-3 opportunity, and the whole comparison is decidable by enumeration: the union, the mean, the minimal safe fixed budget and every arm's op count are exact integers, and the only free choice -- the discovery price -- is declared and swept, so the frontier is reported as a function of it rather than asserted at one point. The blind twin holds the discovery cost fixed and removes the discovery information, which is the control that separates 'paying to choose' from 'choosing well'
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) The measured minimal safe fixed budget B_min equals |union E(x)| EXACTLY in all NINE cells -- 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 8, 16, 16, 4 -- which is TMT-3's E_* superset-of-union requirement realized as a measurement rather than a derivation. (2) The measured structural opportunity equals |union| - mean exactly in every cell: 0, 1, 3, 7, 15, 4, 12, 8, 0. (3) FIXED_DENSE, DYNAMIC and ORACLE are exact on EVERY input of every cell (fraction exactly 1); FIXED_SPARSE(B) has exactness exactly C(min(B,q), j) / C(q, j) at every budget B in 0..16, in every POINTER cell. (4) The blind negative twin is exact on exactly 1 / C(q,j) of the inputs: 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/70, 1/1820, 1/12870 in the POINTER cells and 1 in WINDOW_j4 -- so at q = 16, j = 8 an arm that pays the full discovery cost and ignores the query is wrong on 12869 of 12870 inputs. (5) At unit discovery price c_s = 1 the DYNAMIC arm is NOT the cheapest exact arm in ANY of the nine cells: its cost 16 + j always exceeds the minimal safe fixed graph's cost q <= 16. (6) The crossover c_s* = (|union| - j)/16 below which DYNAMIC beats the minimal safe fixed graph is exactly 0, 1/16, 3/16, 7/16, 15/16, 1/4, 3/4, 1/2, 0 in the nine cells, and the swept frontier agrees with it at every grid price. (7) The dense-minus-oracle apparent gap (16 - j) OVERSTATES TMT-3's bound by exactly 16 - |union| in every cell: 15, 14, 12, 8, 0, 8, 0, 0, 12. It overstates by nothing exactly when the union is the whole legal set (q = 16), which is the only regime in which the popular dense-versus-dynamic comparison measures the theorem's quantity. (8) The WINDOW control has opportunity exactly 0 and c_s* exactly 0, so no positive discovery price admits the dynamic arm there
